verdict.rationale: Whether a software service's source is published under an open license is a fair question even for a government tax portal, since public agencies can and do open-source their systems, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions source code, a repository, or an open license. It covers only filing services, IRS-aligned XML schemas, an Open Data Portal for business-license data (open data, not open source), and probes showing no machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
